description: Which stages the procedure established by an instrument consists of, and whether it carries a structural defect (O-5, DECISION-0052). The stages, the transitions and the condition of every transition are reconstructed from the formalisation rather than retold: what leads from where to where, and under what condition. The check of the graph: unreachable stages, dead transitions, a transition that enters no stage at all. Without package — the list of instruments whose procedure is formalised. A stage with no exit is named but is NOT counted as a defect: whether it is terminal by design cannot be seen from the formalisation.

package.description: the instrument; without it — the list of instruments that carry procedures

name: law_process
